title: Data and code for: Gradient-based tuning of FOPID controllers through physics-informed fractional surrogates: experimental validation on a thermal process
description:
Jupyter notebooks (NB01–NB04), experimental data recorded on a Temperature Control Lab (TCLab, Arduino Leonardo, firmware 2.0.1) and analysis scripts supporting the article Gradient-based tuning of FOPID controllers through physics-informed fractional surrogates: experimental validation on a thermal process (submitted to Control Engineering Practice).

Contents: open-loop identification experiments (NB01), fractional physics-informed neural network (fPINN) identification (NB02), differentiable FOPID tuning with robustness constraints and baselines (NB03), and 15 closed-loop runs on the kit (5 controllers × 3 repetitions × 3 operating points, NB04).
